blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) backed calls to protect the rights and livelihoods of small-scale Filipino fisherfolk, reiterating a statement by Kalookan Bishop Pablo Virgilio Cardinal David seeking justice for those who “help feed our nation.” CBCP President and Lipa Archbishop Gilbert Garcera, in a pastoral statement Friday, Nov. 27, echoed David’s appeal for the Supreme Court (SC) to reconsider its decision on the vessel monitoring system and for Congress to strengthen legal protections for municipal waters and ensure the effective monitoring of commercial fishing vessels.
